title: Kissed Shaggy Canadien Branston-Pickle Bake
description: This festive Canadian dish features the briny, sweet and sour taste of branston pickle, wrapped in a hearty, comforting blanket of fluffy pastry. The earthy, tamasic flavors of whole wheat and oats are tempered by the creamy richness of buttermilk.

ingredients.name: buttermilk
ingredients.notes: plus extra for brushing pasty tops

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, oats, and salt. Add in cold butter and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the dry ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs.
Next, in a separate bowl, whisk together buttermilk and eggs until well combined. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until the dough just comes together in a shaggy mass.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 5-7 minutes, until the dough begins to come together and become smooth.
Divide the dough in half and shape each half into a round, about 1 inch thick. Place each round on a lightly floured baking sheet, leaving about 1 inch of space between them.
Brush the tops of each round with a little extra buttermilk and sprinkle with a pinch of salt. Bake in a wood-fired oven at 425F for 20-25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and set.
While the pastry is baking, sauté the chopped onion in a little butter until softened. Stir in chopped fresh parsley and a pinch of black pepper.
Once the pastry is done, let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing in half and serving with a dollop of chopped branston pickle on top, and a sprinkle of extra parsley if desired.
Garnish with extra branston pickle and parsley for a festive touch, and serve with a steaming cup of hot coffee or tea for a truly Canadian breakfast experience.
